scope.parameters: fadd with params[3] = 1 (addition); examples: gcd(a + b, n) = 1, a ≠ b, a > 1, b > 1

contrast.rule: The value (a + b)/(2n) is also what 'averaging the two fractions' gives, for EVERY like-fraction sum, so no item can separate add-denominators from averaging by value. Only the written form separates them: '(a+b)/(2n)' written unsimplified (e.g. 8/18) supports add-denominators; a simplified equal value (4/9) leaves both open.
